_howto: Each call: call, means, icon (optional), phins (true = Phins call).

calls.means: The ball has left the ruck. The ruck is over, so defenders can go.
We're waiting for the "Ball's out!" call. Hold your spot until then.
Defense, move up together. Line speed!
I'm running around behind the ruck to get back into the line.
Form a pod of 3 with me. Never go alone.
I'm the lazy in this pod, a few feet behind the 9.
Pod call. The next pod sets up in the same formation while the first pod runs.
Pod call. Ball to the 10 through the sacred channel. Lead and plus still run through.
Maul defense: do not engage, part the sea.
Maul defense: ENGAGE! Stop the maul!
Green zone call (their 22). Push hard and fast on the gain line to get into the in-goal, but NOT FRANTIC.
Red zone exit: a box kick off the ruck.
Red zone exit: a pass and kick from the 10, 12, or 15.
